prompt_data.main_prompt: Design a captivating T-shirt for DreamShaperXL Turbo featuring an LCM-LoRA Test-themed fast circuit design in a minimalist tech aesthetic with clean typography. The design should include geometric shapes and sleek lines, all rendered in a monochromatic color palette with accent colors for added depth. Typography should be modern and legible, maintaining a clean and simple look that works well on T-shirts.
prompt_data.negative_prompt: Avoid overly complex designs, low-quality imagery, and unprofessional typography. Keep the focus on minimalist tech aesthetics while avoiding cluttered layouts and excessive use of accent colors.
